title: Naming check
checkNamesTitle: Double-click or drag to check the names
browserHint: Select folders or files in the target folder and press Check names; sub-folders are included.
checkAgainTitle: Check the same folders again, e.g. after renaming
emptyHint: Choose folders on the left and press Check names.
emptyDetail: Every video inside them (sub-folders included) is compared with the name the chosen rename rules would give it. Only names are read, so even a whole library is quick.
summary_one: {flagged} of {count} file needs a look · rules “{rule}” · checked {date}
summary_other: {flagged} of {count} files need a look · rules “{rule}” · checked {date}
allGood: Every file already has the right name.
namesColumn: Current name → name from the rules
expectedTitle: The name the rules would give this file
nameUnchanged: The rules would keep this name
tooMany: Rename takes at most {max} files at once
fixTitle: Open the selected files in Rename, with the same rules, to check and apply the new names
deleteMessage: Delete this naming check result? The files are not touched.
rulesChanged: the rules changed since: press Check again
goneText: No longer here: renamed, moved or deleted since the check
allFixed: Every file listed by this check has been renamed or moved.
